name: Mushi
overview: The name Mushi appears in Scripture as one of the sons of Merari, who was a son of Levi, highlighting Mushi's place within the Levitical genealogies. Both Exodus 6:19 and 1 Chronicles 6:19 identify Mushi alongside Mahali as part of the families of Levi, emphasizing their role in the organization of the Levites. Additionally, 1 Chronicles 6:47 traces the lineage through Mushi back to Levi, underscoring the continuity of the Levitical line and its significance in Israel's priestly heritage.
